title: Bound on reachable vertices
statement: Let $r,K,v$ be natural numbers. If there is a vertex $u<K$ accepted by the initial-vertex oracle query for $r$, and there is a finite sequence of zero or more transitions from $u$ to $v$ in which each transition is accepted by the step oracle query for $r$ and ends at a vertex less than $K$, then $v<K$.
hypotheses_covered: There exists $u<K$ accepted by the initial-vertex oracle query
There is a reflexive-transitive sequence of oracle-accepted transitions from $u$ to $v$, each ending below $K$
